# RESOLVI — API Reference

**Class:** `scviva.model.ResolVI`

**Signature:** `ResolVI(adata)`

## Docstring

ResolVI corrects segmentation errors and background noise in cellular-resolution
spatial transcriptomics data (Xenium, MERFISH, CosMx).

______________________________________________________________________

## User Guide

ResolVI is a semi-supervised, deep generative model for denoising cellular-resolved
spatial transcriptomics data.
